articles.title: Not cool: who hacked France’s supermarket fridges?
articles.summary:
Whether it was youngsters proving their skills or state sabotage, Europe’s most hacked country was left with a mountain of waste after food began cooking in freezers

Shortly before midnight last Sunday, the digital thermostats controlling hundreds of supermarket cold aisles across France began to flicker and rise.

In a “bizarre and unprecedented” cyber-attack, hackers had remotely overridden the temperature settings on thousands of freezers, fridges and chiller cabinets pushing them from as low as -27C (-16.6F) to well over 50C (122F).

articles.title: French schoolchildren have been treated like violent criminals – for telling the truth | Rokhaya Diallo
articles.summary:
To protest against the shameful conditions in some French schools is entirely legitimate. The government’s response is not

As a secondary school pupil in 1994, I took part in protests against a reform that would have allowed French employers to pay young people below the minimum wage. Our campaign was successful, but if we had had to face the terrifying police response unleashed on student protesters in France over recent weeks, I would have stayed at home.

A 14-year-old boy, Eden, suffered a fractured jaw and had teeth knocked out after a police teargas grenade struck him in the face. Sixteen-year-old Maël lost the sight in one eye allegedly after being struck by a shot from an LBD, a form of rubber-bullet launcher. Evan, 15, had his hand blown off in an explosion involving a police stun grenade. And in Dunkirk, a police SUV is alleged to have driven repeatedly at groups of secondary school pupils, as an officer could be heard saying: “Come closer, we’ll smash their fucking faces in.” Accounts from children left terrified by brutal treatment in police custody describe traumatic experiences with severe psychological and physical consequences.

articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: Russia building non-negotiable ‘security zone’ inside Ukrainian border, Putin declares
articles.summary:
Russian president says area will not be part of any potential peace talks while Kremlin says the zone spans 660km. What we know on day 1,697

Russia is establishing a “security zone” inside Ukraine along the border and it will be non-negotiable in any ⁠future talks with Kyiv, Vladimir Putin has said. The Russian president, wearing military uniform and speaking during a visit to a command post, said the operation ⁠was in response to Ukraine’s ⁠2024-25 incursion into ​Russia’s western Kursk region. “The Russian armed forces were tasked not only with expelling the enemy from our land but also with establishing a security zone ⁠in the adjacent territory. This task is being carried out successfully,” he said in televised comments on Friday. “Our goal is to ensure the absolute security of Russia’s border regions ⁠for the future, and we do not plan to make this a subject for potential peace negotiations with ​Ukraine.”

The planned ‌security zone spanned 660km (410 ‌miles), of which 70% was currently under Russia’s control, Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said. Peskov did not say how deep it would ‌reach inside Ukraine. The zone requires Russia to carve out land in the Sumy and Kharkiv regions, which are not among those it is illegally claiming as its own territory.

Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian military’s access to the Starlink satellite internet service had not yet been fully restored, as media reports suggested the order to throttle the service had come from within the White House. The Ukrainian president met European leaders on Friday in Brussels, where he asked the EU for another €70bn ($79bn/£59bn) next year to fund Ukraine’s defence against Russia, report Jennifer Rankin and Andrew Roth. The meeting offered an important opportunity for Zelenskyy and Europe to align their strategies as Zelenskyy was again embroiled in a major quarrel with Donald Trump. Hours earlier the US president called Ukraine’s renewed strikes on Russian oil refineries “a disgrace” after his purported “energy ceasefire” between Russia and Ukraine failed to take hold.

Russian attacks killed at least eight people and injured 60 ⁠across Ukraine on Friday, hit two shopping centres and cut power to more than 1 million people after strikes on the energy grid, ⁠officials said. Two were kiled and 12 more wounded in attacks on three districts of the eastern city of Kharkiv, governor Oleh Syniehubov ⁠said. Further Russian strikes through the evening injured nine, officials said. Attacks in Kramatorsk in the eastern Donetsk region killed two and another two were killed in south-eastern Dnipropetrovsk region.

A drone strike on a food-processing facility killed one person and wounded eight in the north-western region of Volyn, according to governor Roman Romaniuk, leaving 370,000 people temporarily without power. Drone attacks also struck a customs terminal ​and torched about 10 trucks in the town of Kovel, he said. Other attacks hit at least two shopping centres – one in the northern city of Sumy and another in the neighbouring region of ⁠Rivne, officials said.

The attacks came as a new report showed that civilian casualties from Russia’s invasion have climbed steeply. At least 328 civilians were killed and 2,105 wounded last month – a total that is 85% higher than in September last year, the report from the UN human rights office in Kyiv said on Friday. It said intensifying Russian attacks in October already had killed dozens of civilians, including children. “The first two weeks of October were among the deadliest periods for civilians in years,” said Danielle Bell, the UN office head.

As Russian missiles and drones have systematically slammed into power plants in Kyiv and Kharkiv this week, the rolling blackouts and water outages have increasingly resembled a supposed Russian blueprint to destroy life in major Ukrainian cities seen by the Guardian, writes Andrew Roth in this analysis.

archive.security_status_en: The European Union faces escalating pressure in energy markets, tensions in the Black Sea following drone attacks on tankers, and complex negotiations over the seven-year budget. U.S. rhetoric regarding the war in Ukraine and the potential easing of sanctions on Russia's 'shadow fleet' deepens concerns over Western alliance unity and energy supply stability.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na energetických trzích a stupňující se diplomatický tlak na dosažení kompromisu ohledně rozpočtu EU.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in energy markets and escalating diplomatic pressure to reach a compromise on the EU budget are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu napětí kvůli kolapsu energetického příměří na Ukrajině a patové situaci na summitu ohledně dlouhodobého rozpočtu a dodávek plynu. Mezitím geopolitické tlaky ze strany USA a eskalující konflikty vyvíjejí silný tlak na evropskou ekonomickou stabilitu i bezpečnostní architekturu.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union is facing mounting tension due to the collapse of the energy ceasefire in Ukraine and a deadlock at the summit regarding the long-term budget and gas supplies. Meanwhile, geopolitical pressures from the US and escalating conflicts place severe strain on European economic stability and security architecture.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na energetických trzích a stupňující se diplomatické třenice mezi USA a EU ohledně sankční politiky vůči Rusku.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in energy markets and escalating diplomatic friction between the US and the EU regarding sanctions policy against Russia are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu vnitřnímu napětí kvůli rozporům ohledně rozpočtu, migrace a energetické politiky, kterou komplikuje americko-ruská dohoda o dodávkách paliv. Rusko pokračuje v konfiskaci evropských aktiv a Ukrajina obnovila útoky na ruské ropné rafinérie, což vyvolalo ostrou kritiku ze strany USA. Současně se hromadí sociální nepokoje a protesty mladých či hnutí žlutých vest ve Francii, zatímco na vnějších hranicích EU přetrvává silný migrační tlak.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union is facing rising internal tensions over budget disputes, migration, and energy policy, further complicated by a US-Russia fuel supply deal. Russia continues to seize European assets and Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries, drawing sharp criticism from the US. Simultaneously, social unrest and youth and Yellow Vest protests are mounting in France, while strong migratory pressure persists at the EU's external borders.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na energetických trzích a další diplomatické střety mezi USA a EU kvůli obnoveným útokům na ropné rafinérie. Sociální nepokoje ve Francii a debaty o migrační politice budou nadále zatěžovat politickou stabilitu unie.
archive.forecast_en: Persistent tensions in energy markets and further diplomatic clashes between the US and the EU over renewed oil refinery strikes are expected in the coming days. Social unrest in France and debates over migration policy will continue to weigh on the union's political stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním a ekonomickým tlakům, podpořeným novými ruskými útoky na ukrajinskou infrastrukturu a rostoucím napětím ve vztazích s USA ohledně války na Ukrajině. Vnitřní stabilitu unie navíc zatěžují sociální nepokoje ve Francii a Albánii, rostoucí výnosy francouzských dluhopisů blížící se 5 % a sílící politický tlak na přísnější migrační politiku.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating security and economic pressures, driven by new Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and growing transatlantic friction over the war in Ukraine. Internal stability is further strained by social unrest in France and Albania, surging French bond yields approaching 5%, and intensifying political momentum for stricter migration controls.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující diplomatické třenice mezi USA a EU ohledně Ukrajiny a zvýšený tlak na řešení francouzské rozpočtové krize. Sociální napětí a bezpečnostní incidenty budou nadále zaměstnávat představitele unie.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, continued diplomatic friction between the US and EU regarding Ukraine and heightened pressure to address the French budgetary crisis are expected. Social tensions and security incidents will continue to occupy EU leaders.

archive.security_status_cs: Vztahy mezi EU a USA se vyostřují kvůli napětí kolem financování a podpory Ukrajiny a omezení přístupu k síti Starlink. Evropští představitelé na summitu v Bruselu upevnili jednotu a řeší přísnější pravidla pro nelegální migraci i nové obchodní dohody, zatímco Rusko stupňuje útoky na ukrajinskou infrastrukturu a zabíjí evropský majetek.
archive.security_status_en: EU-US relations are souring due to tensions over Ukraine funding and support, alongside restrictions on Starlink access. European leaders solidified unity at the Brussels summit, addressing tighter rules on irregular migration and new trade deals, while Russia intensifies attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and seizes European corporate assets.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně pomoci Ukrajině a vyjednávání o unijním rozpočtu. Růst napětí v transatlantických vztazích bude nadále určovat ekonomickou agendu EU.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvers regarding aid to Ukraine and negotiations over the EU budget are expected. Rising tensions in transatlantic relations will continue to shape the EU's economic agenda.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícímu se geopolitickému napětí v důsledku nejisté americké podpory Ukrajině pod vedením Donalda Trumpa a ruských snah o vytvoření vynucené bezpečnostní zóny. Současně se EU potýká s vnitřními ekonomickými tlaky, dohodami o automobilových subvenčních pravidlech a rostoucími obavami z energetické a migrační krize.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating geopolitical tension due to uncertain U.S. support for Ukraine under Donald Trump and Russian efforts to enforce a non-negotiable security zone. Simultaneously, the EU is grappling with internal economic pressures, agreements on automotive subsidy rules, and mounting concerns over energy and migration.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat intenzivní diplomatické snahy EU o zajištění alternativního financování pro Ukrajinu a reakce na omezení technologií ze strany USA. Pozornost trhů se soustředí na fiskální a energetická jednání na úrovni unijních institucí.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, intensive EU diplomatic efforts to secure alternative financing for Ukraine and responses to U.S. technology restrictions are expected. Market attention will focus on fiscal and energy negotiations at the EU institutional level.
